content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, the figure flagged for watch among the income records.","cites":["kpi:85"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.","cites":["kpi:86","kpi:79"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $7.219 billion in 2020 and $8.122 billion in 2021.","cites":["kpi:83","kpi:84"]},{"claim":"Core Resources income was $1.584 billion in 2024, and Core Resources were 46% of total income that year.","cites":["kpi:74","kpi:80"]},{"claim":"Core Resources income in 2024 included $724.9 million from the private sector, $512.6 million from the public sector and $346.1 million from other partners.","cites":["kpi:76","kpi:75","kpi:77"]},{"claim":"In 2024, Other Resources Regular made up 49% of UNICEF's total income and Other Resources Emergency made up 5%.","cites":["kpi:81","kpi:82"]},{"claim":"In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.","cites":["kpi:95","kpi:96"]}]}
